summary.en: Founded in January 2010, Primer is widely regarded as Korea's first startup accelerator. It has backed 200+ startups including Soomgo, MyRealTrip and idus.

summary.en: Google for Startups Accelerator: Korea is a 10-week, equity-free and free-of-charge program for Seed-to-Series-A Korean startups building AI-driven products. Each cohort has 10-15 startups and the program ends in a mandatory Demo Day with Google leaders and investor mentors.
summary.local: 구글 스타트업 액셀러레이터 코리아는 시드~시리즈A 단계 한국 스타트업을 위한 10주짜리 무료·무지분(equity-free) 프로그램으로, AI 기반 제품을 만드는 팀을 대상으로 한다. 각 기수는 10~15개 스타트업으로 구성되며 구글 리더와 투자 멘토가 참석하는 데모데이로 마무리된다.

sources.title: Google for Startups Accelerator: Korea

sources.quote: Ten weeks … The Accelerator is free of charge and equity-free … Each cohort of 10-15 startups … 100% attendance for the Bootcamp week and a minimum of 80% attendance for online sessions

verification_notes: Equity-free / no cash investment program (not cash-for-equity), included as a prominent multi-sector/AI-general accelerator in Korea. Founded year of the Korea program not specified by Google.

strategy.thesis: Non-profit startup foundation established by 19 financial institutions; provides workspace, direct investment, education and the long-running monthly D.DAY demo day as the gateway to its support programs.

perks: D.CAMP / Front One residency up to 1 year
follow-up investment by D.DAY alliance VCs
program.eligibility: Early-stage startups; D.DAY is the only gateway to D.CAMP residency, investment and support.

application.how_to_apply: Apply to monthly D.DAY demo day via dcamp.kr

summary.en: D.CAMP is operated by the Banks Foundation for Young Entrepreneurs, established by 19 financial institutions in 2012. It provides workspace, education, networking and direct investment, and runs D.DAY — the longest-running monthly demo day in Korea (since June 2013). D.DAY is the gateway to D.CAMP/Front One residency and direct investment of up to ₩300M per company.
summary.local: 디캠프는 2012년 19개 금융기관이 설립한 은행권청년창업재단이 운영한다. 공간·교육·네트워킹·직접투자를 제공하며, 2013년 6월부터 이어진 국내 최장수 월간 데모데이 'D.DAY'를 운영한다. D.DAY는 디캠프·프론트원 입주와 기업당 최대 3억 원 직접투자의 관문이다.
